name: The Unknowns Saga
source: An introduction to the Unknown Saga series, it has no main characters but the story itself is a mystery. This is not your average anime novel or anything boring, this game is all action. Its up to you the reader to uncover the mystery and save the world at the same time.
translation: 《Unknowns Saga》系列简介：没有主要角色，故事本身就是谜团。这不是普通的动画小说，也不是什么无聊作品，游戏充满行动。由读者揭开谜团，同时拯救世界。
